OK so `bn_addn_low` writes all `size` digits. So `c->dp[0..max-1]` are all written by `bn_addn_low`. If `carry == 0`, `c->used = max`, and `bn_trim` reads `c->dp[max-1]` which was written. So no uninitialized read there.

But wait - what if `carry == 1`? Then `bn_grow(c, max + 1)` is called, and `c->dp[max] = carry` is set. Then `c->used = max + 1`. `bn_trim` reads `c->dp[max]` which was set to 1. So that's fine too.
